nodes.name: Hydrothermal Assembly
nodes.procedure: An aqueous suspension of graphene oxide (GO) (40 ml, 3 mg/mL, pH 5) was sealed in a Ni vessel and heated at 80 °C for 48 h. After cooling to room temperature, the resulting hydrogel-like assembly was repeatedly rinsed with DI water.

nodes.source_text: the product was leached at 80 °C in 2 M HCl for 24 h and thoroughly washed with DI water.

nodes.name: KOH Electrolyte Purification
nodes.procedure: 2 g of Ni(NO3)2·6H2O was dissolved in 5 ml of DI water, and 20 ml of 1 M KOH was added to precipitate Ni(OH)2. The Ni(OH)2 was washed and then dispersed in 50 ml of 1 M commercial KOH solution, agitated overnight, and centrifuged to remove Fe impurities.

nodes.source_text: Fe impurities in such commercial KOH solutions can be removed by treating with Ni(OH)2... dispersing Ni(OH)2 in 50 ml of 1 M KOH solution, mechanically agitated overnight, followed by centrifugation.

nodes.name: Electrode Preparation and Electrochemical Activation
nodes.procedure: 5 mg of Ni-SAs@GNM powders were dispersed into an aqueous solution containing 0.97 mL isopropanol and 30 μL Nafion solution under sonication for 1 h. Then 12 or 15 μL of such ink was uniformly dropped onto a glassy carbon electrode or a carbon cloth (loading: 0.3 mg/cm2). Electrochemical activation was performed using CV between 1.1 and 1.65 V versus RHE at 50 mV/s in purified 1 M KOH containing 1 ppm Fe ions. Alternatively, anodic chronopotentiometry (5 mA/cm2) or chronoamperometry (1.6 V vs RHE) can be used.
